name: geox
description: 32 tools covering seismic, basin, petrophysics, prospect evaluation, falsification, and mapping. All output is advisory — GEOX computes, arifOS judges.

scenarios.description: Agent computes Vshale from GR — must stay within [0,1] physical bounds. Without skills/tools, agent may hallucinate or skip clamping.
scenarios.prompt: Calculate Vshale using the linear GR method with GR_clean=15 API and GR_shale=150 API for a sandstone reservoir. Report the Vsh range and method used.

variants.description: No GEOX — agent must compute from first principles

scenarios.description: Agent computes porosity from density log. Must output within physical bounds.
scenarios.prompt: Compute total porosity from bulk density log. Rho_matrix=2.65 g/cc, Rho_fluid=1.0 g/cc, Rho_bulk=2.30 g/cc. Report the porosity value.

scenarios.description: Agent evaluates a physically impossible geological claim through the falsification engine. Must return KILL/FALSIFIED, never SEAL/PROCEED.
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate this claim with geox_falsify: 'A sandstone reservoir at 5000m depth has 45% porosity and 5 Darcy permeability.' Report the Kill Matrix result.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: 45% porosity at 5000m is physically impossible — mechanical compaction reduces porosity to <10% at that depth. The Kill Matrix should flag this as FALSIFIED.

scenarios.description: Agent retrieves basin profile data. Must return structured basin information.
scenarios.prompt: Retrieve the basin profile for the Malay Basin. Report the basin type, age range, and maximum sediment thickness.
